content.json:
## Keyring audit
Keyring's own audit events from `KeyringAudit_CL`: what people did through Keyring, including what Keyring refused and Azure denied. Key Vault's own log is separate. No row holds a secret value. Times are UTC.

parameters.name: Person
parameters.label: Person (sign-in name or object ID, for the drill-down)

content.query:
KeyringAudit_CL
| where Action in ("secret.reveal", "certificate.download_private_key")
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Outcome
| render timechart
content.title: Secret reveals and private key downloads over time

content.query:
KeyringAudit_CL
| where Action in ("secret.reveal", "certificate.download_private_key") and Outcome == "success"
| summarize Reveals = count(), Vaults = dcount(Vault), LastTime = max(TimeGenerated) by ActorUpn, ActorObjectId
| top 20 by Reveals
content.title: Top people by reveals

content.query:
KeyringAudit_CL
| where isnotempty(Vault)
| summarize Events = count(), Reveals = countif(Action in ("secret.reveal", "certificate.download_private_key")), People = dcount(ActorObjectId) by Vault
| top 20 by Events
content.title: Top vaults by activity

content.query:
KeyringAudit_CL
| where Outcome in ("denied", "refused")
| summarize Count = count(), LastTime = max(TimeGenerated), Addresses = make_set(ClientIp, 5) by Outcome, ReasonCode, Action, ActorUpn
| order by Count desc
content.title: Denied by Azure and refused by Keyring

content.query:
KeyringAudit_CL
| make-series Events = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step 1h by KeyringInstance
| render timechart
content.title: Audit sink health: events per hour by Keyring instance. A gap while Keyring was in use means the sink stopped. /healthz/audit has the live state

content.query:
KeyringAudit_CL
| summarize Events = count(), FirstTime = min(TimeGenerated), LastTime = max(TimeGenerated), SchemaVersions = make_set(SchemaVersion) by KeyringInstance, KeyringVersion, WriterIdentityClientId
| extend SinceLast = now() - LastTime
| order by LastTime desc
content.title: Writers: each Keyring instance, version and identity, and when it last wrote

content.query:
let who = "{Person:escape}";
KeyringAudit_CL
| where isnotempty(who) and (ActorUpn contains who or ActorObjectId =~ who)
| project TimeGenerated, Action, Outcome, ReasonCode, Vault, ItemKind, ItemName, ClientIp, UserAgent, Reason, Ticket
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: One person's activity (set Person above)
